profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Squarespace
profile.summary: I am a recent Computer Science graduate with a diverse skill set in full-stack, AI, and mobile application development. With experience in building end-to-end solutions, I enjoy working on projects that bridge innovation with practical problem-solving. I'm passionate about learning new technologies and applying them to create impactful and scalable solutions. Whether it's developing intuitive mobile apps or exploring the potential of AI, I'm always eager to grow as a developer and contribute to meaningful projects

positions.description: Working as a Backend Engineer on the API and Service Frameworks Team, managing and developing the platform services that makeup the products at Squarespace.
positions.insights: Skills: Sping · Java · REST APIs · Backend Development · Continuous Integration (CI) · Software Development · Maven · Model Context Protocol (MCP)

positions.title: Associate Mobile Developer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Mobile Developer for a cross-platform React Native + Expo application that unifies multiple enterprise ERP systems (Maximo, Oracle JDE, Oracle Fusion, SAP) into a single mobile platform. Collaborated within an agile development framework alongside a multidisciplinary team to ensure project milestones aligned with company goals.

Key contributions:
→ Developed React Native mobile solutions integrated with C# backend services
→ Contributed to daily stand-ups in order to maintain team alignment and project momentum
→ Created comprehensive project tickets and user stories for each member of the our cross-functional team
→ Gained experience with large-scale data systems and pipelines.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Mobile Application Development · Asset Management · Database Management System (DBMS) · SQLite · SAP ERP · Maximo · Oracle JDE · Oracle Fusion · Agile Application Development

positions.title: Computer Science TA
positions.description:
Mentored over 300 students in Java programming fundamentals, serving as a bridge between complex technical concepts and student understanding. Specialized in supporting students from diverse academic backgrounds as they developed foundational programming and problem-solving skills.

Key contributions:
→ Provided comprehensive academic support through weekly office hours, online discussion forums, and detailed grading feedback
→ Developed effective teaching strategies for students transitioning from non-CS backgrounds into technical coursework
→ Guided students through debugging processes and analytical problem-solving methodologies
→ Fostered technical skill development across multiple Java-based programming projects and assignments
→ Maintained consistent mentorship role over 2+ years, adapting teaching approaches to diverse learning styles
positions.insights: Skills: Back-End Web Development · Communication · Software Development · Java

projects.title: PAPA Discord Bot
projects.description:
This is my Passive Aggressive Personal Assistant (PAPA) which utilizes Habitica's API to connect my todo-list and daily habits into a discord bot using Python. I am also including Anthropic's Claude API to create passive aggressive reminders to complete my tasks, or create new ones in order to keep me accountable.

Key contributions:
→ Generating contextually aware, personality-driven reminders and task suggestions with Prompt Engineering.
→ Designing automated notification system delivering personalized accountability messages with Discord.py
→ Seamlessly integrating multiple API's with secure authentication and test-driven development.

projects.title: Repair Estimator Mobile App
projects.description:
Developing a React Native mobile application that enables real estate investors to accurately estimate residential property repair costs and generate professional documentation for contractors. Leading the complete product development cycle from initial UX design through cross-platform implementation.

Key contributions:
→ Built comprehensive repair estimation tool with photo capture and detailed cost breakdowns
→ Designed intuitive user experience in Figma and translated designs into fully functional mobile interface
→ Developed PDF export feature enabling investors to share professional estimates with contractors
→ Implemented agile development approach, iterating based on feedback
→ Created end-to-end workflow streamlining property investment decision-making process
